title: Coyle Hall
description: Welcome to Coyle Hall, home of the Crew
content: Welcome to Coyle Hall, where truer words have never been spoken. Formerly known as Fisher Hall, our community now begins its new chapter under a new name, but make no mistake: the spirit remains the same. Home to generations of proud residents affectionately known as the Crew, this brotherhood has long been one of the most tight-knit, spirited, and iconic on campus.

title: History
description: The history of Coyle Hall and Fisher Hall transition
content: Fisher Hall history and transition to Coyle Hall. The legacy continues with the same spirit and traditions. Learn about our rich heritage and the evolution from Fisher to Coyle.

title: Faith
description: Faith and spiritual life at Coyle Hall
content: Faith community and spiritual activities at Coyle Hall including Mass schedule and sacraments. St. Albert the Great Chapel serves our community.

content: Information about the Coyle Hall building, facilities, and amenities. Four floors plus basement, North Quad location, 176 student capacity.

title: Location

content: Coyle Hall is located on North Quad at the University of Notre Dame. Convenient access to dining, academics, and campus life.

title: Contact
content: Get in touch with Coyle Hall staff, leadership, and administration. Phone numbers, email addresses, and office locations.

title: Joey Quinones - Rector
content: Joey Quinones, rector of Coyle Hall. Originally from Southern California, graduated Notre Dame with degrees in Mechanical Engineering, Education, and Entrepreneurship. Former Assistant Rector in Baumer Hall, now leads Coyle Hall community. Also Assistant Coach of Boxing Clubs and works with McDonald Center for Student Well-being.

title: Ryan Lally - RA
content: Ryan Lally, Resident Assistant from St. Louis, MO. Studies Classics and Spanish. Hobbies include boxing, running, calligraphy, and music. Serves the 1st floor of Coyle Hall.

title: Hall Commissioners
description: Coyle Hall commissioners and leadership team
content: Meet the hall commissioners who help lead Coyle Hall activities, events, and community initiatives. Student leadership positions within the hall government structure.
